cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Ask Around the Missing Detail
cards.instruction: Find one hidden fact by asking about everything surrounding it and never naming it directly.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Leave that second cup where it is. Was the tea in it strong or weak?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why don't you just ask who visited while you were out?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll choose the questions. Start with the tea, then tell me whether the sugar bowl was used.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Strong, no sugar. That's how half our friends drink it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we'll narrow it down. Did you bring out the biscuits, or did the bowl of mints have to come down from the shelf?

reason: Remove direct identity questions; A controls a circumstantial inquiry and uses B broad tea match to demand a second hospitality clue without declaring a visitor identity.
